quests.title: The Window Above Blacktown
quests.blurb: I live above the platform at Blacktown and I know this line by sound. Something in the rhythm changed about a month ago and everyone I tell thinks I am mad. Ride it and tell me whether I am mad.

steps.label: ride it and listen to the joins
photograph the stretch that sounds wrong
tell me I am not mad

quests.title: Setting Up at Jubilee Park
quests.blurb: Five in the morning at Jubilee Park, in the dark, unloading a van by feel. The bloke in the next bay has started arriving at four to take half my frontage. I need a witness and I need them at four.

steps.label: the bays, at the hour it happens
the bloke with the extra trestle
you will want one at that hour
$30 of frontage, recovered

quests.title: The Clock at Wentworthville
quests.blurb: The clock on the Wentworthville platform has been four minutes fast since I got here and every relief who comes through wants to fix it. Do not fix it. Find out who set it that way, before they retire.

steps.label: the clock, four minutes fast, for the file
to Westmead, where the old crew drink
bring the name back

quests.title: The Dog at Meadowbank
quests.blurb: Sits at the yellow line at Meadowbank at knock-off, waits, then walks off on its own. Half the platform knows and nobody has done anything, including me, and I have run out of ways to say it politely.

steps.label: the end of the platform, at twenty to six
the street it walks home to
tell me it is not a sad story

quests.title: The Book at John Street Square
quests.blurb: I run a small book on things that are not races — weather, delays, whether the twenty past four out of John Street Square runs on time. Somebody is beating it by information, not luck. Ride the run they ride.

steps.label: ride the run they ride
the two who follow you off it
$35 back off the book

quests.title: Last Service out of Leightonfield
quests.blurb: Nothing runs out of Leightonfield after twenty past four. I lock this end and the woman who runs the newsagent locks the other and in between there is a kilometre of lit platform for nobody. Ride the last one to Villawood and bring me a photograph of that.

steps.label: ride the late one to Villawood
the empty platform, lit and pointless
tell them what you saw

quests.title: The Domestic Airport Tap-Off
quests.blurb: A card ending 98 boards at Domestic Airport on the long weekend and vanishes. Not a fare thing — ninety cents. I want to know *how*, and nobody upstairs wants to hear it.

steps.label: ride the run the card rides
the gap in the fence everyone knows about
photograph it before somebody welds it

quests.title: The Bridge Street Order
quests.blurb: I have made the same order for the same person every morning since I opened at Bridge Street. Since school holidays they have not turned up, and it has been like that since the merge. Go and knock.

steps.label: order one at the Bridge Street kiosk
the office they walk to, or used to
come back with $30 — I am not running a charity

quests.title: Four Minutes at Lewisham
quests.blurb: The board at Lewisham says four minutes. It has said four minutes since before the merge and it is a lie about a third of the time. Stand under it, time it, and bring me numbers instead of feelings.

steps.label: stand under the board and wait like everyone else
photograph the board saying four minutes
ride the one that finally comes
give me the number

quests.title: Unclaimed at Jannali
quests.blurb: Everything anyone leaves on the Jannali line ends up in a room and the room is full. Nine hundred umbrellas and one a esky with no lid with a name on it and a number that rings out. Go to the address on the tag.

steps.label: the address on the tag
the two who got there before you
$37 — whatever it is, it is worth that to somebody

quests.title: The Quiet Carriage, Carlton
quests.blurb: Speakerphone. A wet Monday, Carlton to town, speakerphone. I have made eye contact eleven times and it has achieved nothing.

steps.label: ride the quiet carriage and observe the crime
apply the shame manually
photograph the sign, for the record

quests.title: The Exhibition Centre Shortcut
quests.blurb: Every courier has a route that is not on a map and mine goes through Exhibition Centre. They have started locking one end. Go and find out whether it is locked forever or just locked today.

steps.label: the end they lock
the long way round, so you understand what it costs
$35, which is what the long way costs me a week

quests.title: Possession at Penrith
quests.blurb: We own the track between midnight and four and in that window we are the only people in this city doing anything real. Somebody keeps walking through my possession at Penrith. Find them before a grinder does.

steps.label: where they come through the fence
the ones who think a hard hat is a costume
photograph the gap so I can put a number on the form

quests.title: The Cowan Regular
quests.blurb: A man drank in my front bar by Cowan for 14 years and then stopped, and every regular in here has gone vague on me at once, which means they know. You are not from here. Go and knock.

steps.label: the house they say he moved to
you cannot ask a favour empty-handed
come back and tell me straight

quests.title: Bay 14, Central Chalmers Street
quests.blurb: Two hundred bays at Central Chalmers Street and I have counted two hundred and forty cars in here on a wet Monday. One of them has not moved since March and it has a ticket on it from March.

steps.label: the car, and the ticket, and the date on it
the two arguing over the grass
$40 in fines nobody is going to collect
